questions: What is a credential?
If a credential expires, does it stop opening doors?
What is choice?
If choice expands, does everyone gain the same freedom?
What are standards?
If standards rise, does everyone's performance rise too?
What is merit?
If merit decides the outcome, does the best person always win?
How does gatekeeping work?
If gatekeeping is relaxed, can everyone get in?
What is capital?
If capital runs out, is there nothing left to pass on?
What is equity?
If equity is divided equally, does everyone get the same amount?
What is access?
If access is granted, does everyone get in?
How does sorting work?
If sorting stops, does everyone end up together?
What does ranking do?
If a ranking rises, does that mean it got better?
What is mobility?
If mobility is restored, can everyone move again?
What is reproduction?
If reproduction stops, does the pattern end?
What is evaluation?
If an evaluation is positive, does that mean it should continue?
What is reform?
Once a reform is complete, is the problem fixed for good?
What is voice?
If a voice is heard, does it get a say?
